title: Inauthentic complaint, Section 3 deactivation (retail-arbitrage style)
basis: Seller Forums UK thread quoting 'deactivated ... in accordance with Section 3 of Amazon's Business Solutions Agreement' and 'Copies of invoices or receipts from your supplier issued in the last 365 days'; US forum threads listing the invoice fields Amazon requires.
text:
Subject: Your Amazon.co.uk selling account

Hello,

Your Amazon Seller account has been deactivated and your listings have been removed in accordance with Section 3 of Amazon's Business Solutions Agreement. Funds will not be transferred to you but will stay in your account while we review.

Why is this happening?
We received complaints from customers about the authenticity of items you listed. The ASINs affected are:
ASIN: B07KJ3M8QA
ASIN: B08RT2N6LX

How do I reactivate my account?
To reactivate your selling account, please send us:
-- Copies of invoices or receipts from your supplier issued in the last 365 days for the ASINs listed above. The invoices must show the supplier's name, address and phone number, your name and address, and the quantity purchased.
-- A plan of action that explains the root cause of the complaints, the actions you have taken to resolve them, and the steps you have taken to prevent them in the future.

You can submit an appeal from the Account Health page in Seller Central.

Seller Performance Team
Amazon.co.uk

title: Order Defect Rate deactivation (seller-fulfilled)
basis: ODR deactivation email quoted by consultants: 'removed your selling privileges, canceled your listings, and placed a temporary hold on any funds ... your order defect rate (ODR) does not meet Amazon's performance target of less than 1%'.
text:
Subject: Your Amazon.com selling privileges have been removed

Hello,

We are writing to let you know that we have removed your selling privileges, canceled your listings, and placed a temporary hold on any funds in your seller account. Any new selling accounts you open will be closed.

We took this action because your order defect rate (ODR) does not meet Amazon's performance target of less than 1%. Your ODR for seller-fulfilled orders over the last 60 days is 3.4%. ODR is the percentage of orders that received negative feedback, an A-to-z Guarantee claim, or a service chargeback.

Any amounts paid as a result of A-to-z Guarantee claims and chargebacks may be deducted from your seller account. After 90 days, the hold will be removed and any remaining funds will be available according to your settlement schedule.

To reactivate your account, submit a plan of action that explains the root cause of the defects, the steps you have taken to resolve them, and how you will prevent them going forward. Go to Account Health in Seller Central and click Appeal.

Seller Performance
Amazon.com

title: Trademark complaint from a rights owner (listing removed)
basis: Forum-quoted wording: 'We removed one or more of your listings because we received a notice from a rights owner that the product detail page may infringe the rights owner's trademark' and 'We may only accept retractions that the rights owner submits to us directly'.
text:
Subject: Notice: Policy Warning

Hello,

We removed one or more of your listings because we received a notice from a rights owner that the product detail page may infringe the rights owner's trademark. The rights owner communication about the alleged infringement and the listings containing the trademarked terms are at the bottom of this message.

ASIN: B09WQ4ZP7C
Infringement type: Trademark
Trademark number: 5123456
Complaint ID: 11223344556
Rights owner: Northfield Outdoor Gear LLC
Rights owner email: legal@northfield-outdoor.example

If you believe the rights owner made an error, contact them and ask them to submit a retraction. We may only accept retractions that the rights owner submits to us directly. We do not accept forwarded or attached retractions.

If you have a letter of authorization from the rights owner or an invoice showing you purchased the items from the rights owner or an authorised distributor, you can submit an appeal from the Account Health page.

Further intellectual property complaints may result in the deactivation of your selling account.

Amazon.com

title: Related account deactivation
basis: Forum-quoted wording: 'We found that your account is related to another account that may not be used to sell on the site. As a result, you may no longer sell on Amazon.com through this account' and 'we do not provide details on our investigation methods'.
text:
Subject: Your Amazon.com seller account

Hello,

We found that your account is related to another account that may not be used to sell on our site. As a result, you may no longer sell on Amazon.com through this account. Any listings in this account have been removed and funds have been placed on hold.

Due to the nature of our business, we do not provide details on our investigation methods.

If you believe we made this decision in error, go to the Account Health page in Seller Central and submit an appeal. Explain how your account is connected to the related account and provide supporting documents, such as a business license or utility bill showing the business address, and evidence that any related account issues have been resolved.

Amazon.com Seller Performance

title: Identity verification required (video call)
basis: Forum-quoted wording: 'We have received your request to reactivate your account, but we do not have sufficient information to complete your request. Read the instructions in this email to complete your identity verification'.
text:
Subject: Action required: verify your identity

Hello,

We have received your request to reactivate your account, but we do not have sufficient information to complete your request. Read the instructions in this email to complete your identity verification and reactivate your account.

To verify your identity, you need to join a video call with an Amazon associate. During the call you will be asked to show:
- The original of the government-issued ID you provided during registration
- The original of the document you provided as proof of address, such as a bank statement or utility bill

To schedule your video call, go to the Account Health page in Seller Central and choose an available time. You must be the primary contact person on the account.

Thank you,
Amazon Seller Identity Verification

title: Funds withheld after deactivation (disbursement request)
basis: Recorded Amazon wording: 'your disbursements were temporarily disabled for a period of 90 days, pending settlement of returns, refunds, A-to-z claims ... in accordance with the Funds Withholding Policy' and 'send a request to disbursement-appeals@amazon.com'.
text:
Subject: Update about the funds in your seller account

Hello,

Due to the recent deactivation of your seller account, your disbursements were temporarily disabled for a period of 90 days, pending settlement of returns, refunds, A-to-z claims from customers, inventory removal costs, outstanding fees and other transactions in accordance with the Funds Withholding Policy.

The 90-day settlement period has ended and requests for disbursement can now be considered. To request a disbursement of your remaining balance, send a request to disbursement-appeals@amazon.com from the email address associated with your seller account. Include your merchant token, the original notification you received at the time of deactivation, and a bank statement showing the account holder name matches your seller account.

Amazon Services

title: Product safety complaint (test report and certificate requested)
basis: Compliance guides and seller forum threads: Amazon's Product Safety team requests test reports from an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab, certificates of compliance, and product/label images after customer safety complaints.
text:
Subject: Product safety concern about your listing

Hello,

We received customer reports that the product listed below may present a safety risk. Customers reported that the charging cable overheated during use. As a precaution, we have removed the listing while we review it.

ASIN: B0CX9L4TQ2
Product: 20W USB-C wall charger

To have the listing reviewed for reinstatement, provide the following by 20 October 2026:
1. A test report from an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory showing the product complies with UL 62368-1.
2. A Certificate of Compliance that lists the product, the manufacturer and the safety standard.
3. Images of the product, its packaging and its label showing the manufacturer's name and model number.

Submit the documents from the Account Health page in Seller Central. If you do not respond, the listing will remain removed.

Amazon Product Safety Team

title: Restricted product, category requires approval

title: Appeal form with set questions (questionnaire)
basis: Account Health appeal flows 'can include submitting a questionnaire, acknowledging a violation, completing a quiz, or providing supporting documents' (recorded research).
text:
Subject: Your appeal: please answer the questions below

Hello,

Your account was deactivated because your late shipment rate did not meet the target of less than 4%. To help us review your appeal, answer each of the following questions:

1. What caused the late shipments on your seller-fulfilled orders?
2. What actions have you taken to resolve the orders that shipped late?
3. What changes have you made to prevent late shipments in the future?

Submit your answers from the Account Health page in Seller Central.

Seller Performance

title: Listing policy violation, with the email's own date (30-day window)
basis: Tests the date logic: a notice that states a length ('within 30 days') and carries its own sent date should count from that date, not from today.
text:
From: Amazon Seller Performance <seller-performance@amazon.com>
Sent: Thursday, September 3, 2026 9:14 AM
Subject: Listing policy violation

Hello,

We removed your listing for ASIN B0D2KX7RFN because it violates our detail page policy. The product title and bullet points contain medical claims ("cures joint pain") that are not allowed.

To reinstate the listing, remove the claims from the detail page and submit a plan of action that explains why the claims were added and how you will prevent it from happening again. Include screenshots or other proof of the corrected listing.

You can appeal within 30 days of this notice from the Account Health page in Seller Central.

Amazon Seller Performance
